milestones.title: First woman to finish Comrades
milestones.description: Finished in a field of men, 42 years before the next woman
milestones.name: Frances HAYWARD

milestones.title: Betty Cavanagh joins the fight
milestones.description: Ran 10 times (1970–1982), first women's race winner in 1975
milestones.name: Betty CAVANAGH

milestones.title: Isavel Roche-Kelly — a medal named in her honour
milestones.description: Won women's race in 1980 & 1981, first woman sub-7 hours. The Isavel Roche-Kelly medal is named after her
milestones.name: Isavel ROCHE-KELLY
